zh: 维也纳工业大学（Technische Universität Wien，简称TU Wien）成立于1815年，是奥地利最大的自然科学技术研究及教育机构，同格拉茨工大及雷欧本采矿冶金大学共同建立了奥地利技术大学联盟（TU Austria）。在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第197位。学校主教学楼大部分坐落于维也纳市中心卡尔斯广场，由八个主要院系及各个职能部门组成，分别是规划与建筑学院、土木工程学院、电子与信息技术学院、计算机学院、机械工程与企业经济学学院、数学与地理信息学院、物理学院等。
en: Technische Universität Wien (TU Wien), founded in 1815, is Austria's largest research and educational institution for natural sciences and technology. It co-founded the Austrian University of Technology Alliance (TU Austria) together with Graz University of Technology and Leoben Mining University. Ranked 197th in the QS World University Rankings 2026, most of the university's main buildings are located on Karlsplatz in central Vienna, consisting of eight main faculties and various administrative departments, including the Faculty of Architecture and Planning, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering and Economics, Mathematics and Geoinformation, Physics, etc.
